stories.headline: Federal Reserve Holds Interest Rates Steady Ahead of Midterms. Here's What That Means for the Market.
stories.body: Key PointsAt today's FOMC meeting, the Fed kept interest rates unchanged.

stories.headline: Fed will drop one interest rate vote next year; two in 2028
stories.body: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said the Federal Open Market Committee will continue to meet eight times a year, but one such meeting will not include an interest rate vote or an official policy statement.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley are dominating the AI stock boom. Here's their edge
stories.body: Wall Street’s Big Three have generated $52 billion in equity trading revenue this year, capturing about 80% of the market on rising margin lending to hedge funds.
